title: Daily English Affirmations for Speaking, Confidence & Fluency - “I am a fluent English speaker”

header.titleZh: 關於口語、自信和流利程度的每日英語肯定語 - “我能說一口流利的英語”

sentences.en: Welcome back to my slow English podcast. Welcome to this powerful daily practice of English fluency affirmations. Learning a language isn't just about learning vocabulary and grammar. It's also about mindset.

sentences.en: They're short positive affirmations designed to rewire your brain, build confidence in yourself, and remind.
sentences.tc: 它們是簡短的正面肯定，旨在重新連接您的大腦，建立對自己的信心並進行提醒。
